item.title: Video Claiming To Show Amit Shah Saying BJP Will End ‘Khalsa Raj’ In Punjab Is Doctored
item.description: A viral video claims to show Amit Shah saying BJP will end 'Khalsa Raj’ in Punjab. Fact check finds the clip doctored; the original speech contains no such remark.

item.title: Sanju Samson Appointed As DSP In Kerala? Here’s The Truth Behind Viral Claim - Newschecker
item.description: A viral social media post claims that Indian cricketer Sanju Samson has been appointed as a DSP in Kerala Police.

item.title: Fact Check: Viral Video Does Not Show Indians Burning PM Modi’s Effigy For ‘Creating Tensions With Iran’
item.description: A viral video of Indians burning PM Modi’s effigy for allegedly creating tensions with Iran and siding with Israel amid the current conflict in West Asia. Our fact check found the claim to be untrue.

item.title: Fact Check: Viral Video Does Not Show Israeli Journalist Confirming Netanyahu’s Death
item.description: A viral video falsely claims to show an Israeli journalist confirming Netanyahu’s death. Fact-check reveals the man is a mayor discussing missile damage.

item.title: Viral Photo Claiming To Show Venue Covered In Litter After PM Modi’s Kolkata Rally Is AI-Generated
item.description: The viral photo claiming to show the venue covered in litter after PM Modi’s Kolkata rally is AI-generated.

item.title: West Asia Crisis: 2020 Video From Ajman Market Shared As Massive Fire At Dubai Airport
item.description: A viral video claiming to show a massive fire at Dubai Airport during the West Asia crisis is misleading. The footage is from a 2020 market fire in Ajman, UAE.

item.title: Viral Video Claiming To Show Ex-Army Chief Calling Indian Army An ‘Ethnic Force’ Is Manipulated
item.description: A viral video claiming to show former Army Chief Gen Manoj Pande calling Indian Army an ‘ethnic force’ is manipulated. The original speech shows no such remarks.

item.description: A viral video claiming to show Hindus crowding streets on Eid in Delhi’s Uttam Nagar streets is false. Our fact check reveals the truth.

item.title: Viral Video Does Not Show Massive Crowd Waiting To Watch Dhurandhar 2
item.description: A viral video claiming to show a massive crowd waiting to watch Dhurandhar 2 is misleading. The footage is actually from 2023 during Gadar 2 screenings, as confirmed by older social media posts.
